# Performance harness: the v0.10.0 Yrs baseline (E-PERF-29)

Every figure cites the run that printed it (`[run JOB/RUN:field]`, checked by `tools/evidence/check.py`). Measurements only. The harness is `tools/perf/` (`tools/README.md`, Performance harness): the kit built with **no features** (as a host builds it), every call timed alone, the median of 5 runs per side, the sides interleaved A, B, A, B on one node. Times are in **ns**.

**Known issue (found 11-02):** same-seed fixtures aren't byte-identical across jobs (`tools/README.md`, Performance harness). `46462c69`'s two sides grew their own fixtures, which happen to be the same size: 13,168,640 [run 46462c69/perfh_grow_h10000_A:store_bytes] and 13,168,640 [run 46462c69/perfh_grow_h10000_B:store_bytes] bytes; the calibration's 10k fixture was 17,379,328 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_h10000_A:store_bytes] bytes. From the J1 reruns on, both sides of a pair read one fixture.

## J1-10k: v0.10.0 at 10k versions (A/A)

**The p99 column of `46462c69` is contaminated** by copy-back first-need rebuilds: the harness copied the fixture back in and reopened 143 [run 46462c69/perfh_h10000_run_A1:restores] times a run, and the first warm call after each reopen paid the provenance map's build, so 1.43% [derived] of a warm row's samples carried it. Fixed at `420561c` (an untimed warm-up of every row after each open). Its p99s are not cited here; its p50, its p95 and the A/A floor stand (the p95 lies beyond the 1.43%).

- **The A/A floor:** B/A at p50 is within 980–1,010 ×1000 on every row except `tick` and `notes` (above); that is what the paired rule (p50 ≤ 1.1×, p99 ≤ 1.5× of the baseline) is measured against.
- **Sample counts:** 10,000 a run on every row except the capped ones (60 s of timed calls a run): `open` and `first_edit` 4,951 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_open_A:n_min], `notes` 5,724 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_notes_A:n_min]; their p99 would be indicative in any case.
- **Memory** (heap held, counting allocator): 7,411,382 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_mem_open_bytes_A:p50] bytes after a reopen, 7,593,712 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_mem_warm_bytes_A:p50] after its first edit; the session's estimate 8,474,560 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_mem_estimate_bytes_A:p50]; one engine doc from the store 2,181,450 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_engine_doc_bytes_A:p50]; for 1,654 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_chars_A:p50] characters in 305 [run 46462c69/perfh_med_h10000_live_runs_A:p50] live runs.

- **The warm-up removed `edit`'s, `revert`'s and `tool_sed`'s p99 spikes** from `46462c69`.
- **`edit_with` and `tool_replace` p99s are suspect, not baselines.** Both are stable in all 10 runs and neither row had a spike in `46462c69`, so the spike moved between rows with the harness, not the kit's path. Copy-backs are 1.45% [derived] of a run's rounds (145 [run 478a062a/perfh_h10000_run_A1:restores] a run), above the 1% a p99 needs. The likely cause, not yet checked: a first-need cost per participant, as a warm-up calls each row once with one random participant. The timers can name it.
- **`blame_doc`'s p99 looks like the kit's sampled check:** `DEFAULT_BLAME_CHECK_EVERY` is 100 (1% of blame calls), and it does an O(doc) rebuild; `blame_line` and `blame_doc` alternate, so every sample lands on one row. Not yet confirmed by a timer.
- **Between jobs** (a different fixture, a different harness commit) p50s moved by up to about 14% [derived] (`store_probe`), more than the A/A floor inside one job: a figure belongs to its fixture (known issue above).

## Why same-seed fixtures differ in size

Job `bfe039f1` (`tools/perf/store-spread.sh`, a shared node, harness `194eee1c`): one binary, one seed, 8 fixtures at 10k and 2 at 100k. Bytes:

| Fixture | File | Data | Free space in the file | Pages in use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10000_1 | 10,010,624 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_1:file_bytes] | 3,889,819 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_1:redb_stored_bytes] | 4,258,818 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_1:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 2,162 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_1:redb_allocated_pages] |
| 10000_2 | 13,168,640 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_2:file_bytes] | 3,889,789 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_2:redb_stored_bytes] | 7,417,020 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_2:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 2,159 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_2:redb_allocated_pages] |
| 10000_6 | 19,484,672 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_6:file_bytes] | 3,889,817 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_6:redb_stored_bytes] | 13,733,004 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_6:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 2,159 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_6:redb_allocated_pages] |
| 10000_7 | 10,010,624 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_7:file_bytes] | 3,889,789 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_7:redb_stored_bytes] | 4,259,004 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_7:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 2,159 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_10000_7:redb_allocated_pages] |
| 100000_1 | 114,225,152 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_1:file_bytes] | 39,674,684 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_1:redb_stored_bytes] | 70,329,497 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_1:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 19,365 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_1:redb_allocated_pages] |
| 100000_2 | 85,803,008 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_2:file_bytes] | 39,675,968 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_2:redb_stored_bytes] | 41,906,041 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_2:redb_fragmented_bytes] | 19,365 [run bfe039f1/perfh_store_100000_2:redb_allocated_pages] |

The data and the pages in use are the same across fixtures, within small differences; the file's length differs because its free space does. So the spread is redb's file, not the kit's content, and there is no kit finding on the data. Most of a store file at these sizes is free space. Not established: why the free space differs between runs, and whether it moves timings (the between-job differences above can't separate it from the job itself; the 2-fixture baseline will show that).

## Calibration (one run per size, shared node: indicative only)

- **Fixtures:** 10k grew in 4 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_h10000_A:grow_s] s, 100k in 76 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_h100000_A:grow_s] s, 1M in 4,260 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_h1000000_A:grow_s] s; the store at 1M is 682,668,032 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_h1000000_A:store_bytes] bytes. The 3 MiB doc: 3,118,720 [run 67650276/perfh_grow_large10000_A:content_bytes] bytes of text at 10k versions.
- **Hooked against plain** (the kit's test hooks on, as its own tests and the soak build it): p50 within single-run noise on every row; p99 not judged (one run each, n=2000). A bound needs the 5-run interleaved pair.
- The calibration's p99s carry the same copy-back artifact as J1-10k; none is cited.

## Empty slots

`fork(V)` (E-PERF-35) and `changed_since(V)` (E-PERF-34): **no Yrs path**. Empty until the native engine; never zeros. `write_base` (3 others' edits after the read) is the Yrs stand-in for E-PERF-34.
